dict.string: Super Converter asks Pages, Numbers, Keynote and Microsoft Office to export the files you convert with them.
Super Converter reads the files you convert from your Desktop and saves the results next to them.
Super Converter reads the files you convert from your Documents folder and saves the results next to them.
Super Converter reads the files you convert from your Downloads folder and saves the results next to them.
